input.title: 2022 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 12 360
input.descriptionHtml:
Save Big on our 2022 Model Clearance!
All boats are new and come with a full warranty starting on their purchase date!

Check out the Pro Angler 12 360 XR - NEW FOR 2024!

Financing Available!

 

With the MirageDrive 360 and Kick-Up fins, move through the water without constraints, going exactly where you want to go. Effortlessly spin and move in every direction. With Hobies new Kick-Up Fins which immediately retract on impact even shallow areas are now entirely navigable. Logs, kelp, shallows, rocks, no problem. Dominate the water, fresh or salt. The Pro Angler 12 deploys all the big-boat fishing features of the 'PA' series on a 12-ft. long platform that fits neatly in the bed of most any pickup truck. Keep a half-dozen rods rigged and ready in the four standard horizontal and two molded-in rod holders. Confidently stand and fire, cast after cast. The elevated Vantage ST seat makes it easy to move around the boat.  You'll love the retractable skeg for improved course-keeping, as well as the innovative H-Rail for superior flexibility in accessory rigging.

Length: 12' / 3.66 m
Width: 36" / .91 m
Hull Weight: 109.5 LBS / 49.7 KG
Fully Rigged Weight: 132.5 LBS / 60.1 KG
Capacity: 500 lbs / 227 kg
Vantage Seat Capacity:  350 lbs / 159 kg
Crew:  1
 


 
*Must be approved by Synchrony Financial with a large enough credit line to cover the purchase price. Call (815) 433-2200 for more info
